Thanks again for volunteering to join a short group walkthrough of Redwood Inference next week. To keep things tight we want to run a single 50-minute session covering: 1) a 20-min product walkthrough tuned to production economics (latency/cost examples), 2) 20-min Q&A + customer use-case breakouts, 3) 10-min next steps + trial access. Draft agenda attached.

To reduce back-and-forth I’m proposing two candidate blocks (both PST):
- Option A: Thu Jul 23, 09:00–09:50 PST
- Option B: Fri Jul 24, 16:00–16:50 PST

Please reply with your preferred option (A or B) and any absolute blocks. If neither works, propose one slot in your local time and we’ll try to accommodate. I’ve cc’d Monica who will consolidate and send the calendar invite once we lock a time.

Attachments: group_demo_agenda.pdf, proposed_blocks.ics

Thanks —
